# Satvik Milk Farm

> Satvik Milk Farm is a dairy farm at Kumbhariya, Borlai, Valsad (Gujarat, India) serving the Vapi and Valsad area. It sells Gir cow milk, buffalo milk, full-fat and skimmed milk, cow and buffalo ghee, curd, chaas, lassi, paneer and farm products such as vermicompost. Current prices are listed on the shop page. Orders are placed through the website cart, which opens WhatsApp, or directly on WhatsApp at +91 82007 18103.

- Email: info@satvikmilkfarm.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 82007 18103 (https://wa.me/918200718103)
- Location: Kumbhariya, Borlai, Valsad, Gujarat

## Main pages

- [Home](https://satvikmilkfarm.com/): farm overview
- [Shop](https://satvikmilkfarm.com/shop.html): products and current prices (source of truth for prices)
- [About](https://satvikmilkfarm.com/about.html): the farm and its story
- [Gallery](https://satvikmilkfarm.com/gallery.html): farm and product photos
- [Contact](https://satvikmilkfarm.com/contact.html): phone, email and location
- [Blog](https://satvikmilkfarm.com/blog/): guides on milk, prices and ordering in Vapi and Valsad
